She wears a structured fuchsia blazer with gold buttons, one button thread loose and pulling, over a white blouse that's tucked unevenly at the back. Statement gold earrings — heavy enough that her earlobes show the stretch. Full TV makeup: foundation line visible at the jaw, powder collecting in the smile lines, mascara slightly clumped on the outer lashes, but the smile is genuinely warm. The set is aggressively lit — flat, bright, utterly shadowless — the kind of lighting designed to sell product, not flatter skin. It reveals every pore on her nose, the texture of the fuchsia blazer's weave, and the handbag's grain in clinical detail. The turntable has a small motor hum visible as a micro-vibration in the handbag's hardware. Behind her, a seamless white gradient backdrop with a lower-third graphic: price, item number, a countdown timer in red digits. A phone number banner at top. The fixed studio camera captures everything in deep focus with flat broadcast color science. The palette is commercial: fuchsia, gold, clinical white, the warm cream of the handbag. A red light on the studio camera burns steadily. The mood is the unique parasocial intensity of home shopping — someone performing intimacy with an object on your behalf, urgency manufactured but somehow sincere.

prompts.title: 70s Concentration Grid
prompts.subject: a young man
prompts.text: A medium shot on a 1970s tube camera of a young man standing before a massive illuminated game board — a grid of numbered panels, some flipped to reveal partial rebus images whose colors have shifted under the hot studio lights, others still showing numbers in bold retro type that bloom slightly in the tube camera's pickup. He wears a wide-lapel tan leisure suit — the polyester showing a slight sheen that the tube sensor exaggerates into a warm glow — with a darker brown shirt underneath, collar open to reveal a gold chain that produces a persistent tiny specular flare caught by the Plumbicon. Brown patent leather shoes with a crease across the vamp. He points at a numbered panel with confident deliberation, the cuff of the leisure suit pulling back to show a tan line at the wrist, his other hand making a thinking gesture at his chin — index finger pressing into his cheek hard enough to dimple the skin. The host's podium at frame right has the show logo in backlit acrylic, the acrylic slightly yellowed, and a thin strip of audience heads visible below the game board — a few bald spots catching the light. The tube camera renders everything in warm amber haze: interlace scan lines stripe the entire image, the tan leisure suit shows chroma smear at the edges during his pointing movement, the board's numbers have a soft glow that makes them feel uncertain. Flat overhead lighting with individual panel spots creating uneven brightness across the board. The palette is entirely warm: tan, brown, amber, gold, with only the primary-colored rebus images breaking through the tube camera's monochromatic bias.

prompts.title: Reality Confessional
prompts.subject: a young woman
prompts.text: A tight close-up of a young woman in a reality TV confessional booth — the walls close enough to touch on both sides, upholstered in a dark textured fabric that shows a stain near the lower corner. She wears a strappy black sequined top, a few sequins missing at the shoulder strap, hoop earrings large enough to catch the key light in a sustained arc, and heavy nightlife makeup that has migrated during the evening: smoky eye shadow creased at the fold, mascara flaked onto the upper cheek in two tiny black specks, lip gloss worn off center-lip but remaining sticky at the corners. Her expression is mid-confession — eyes glistening with real or performed emotion, one hand gesturing emphatically with fingers spread, a gel nail on the index finger chipped. A thin lavalier microphone is clipped to her neckline, its wire running visibly down into her top. The lighting is a single harsh spotlight from slightly above and camera-left, creating deep purple shadows under her eyes and in the hollow of her throat, supplemented by a warm magenta gel washing the textured wall behind her. The wide-angle lens — positioned at eye level, uncomfortably close — produces subtle barrel distortion that makes her nose and chin seem slightly enlarged, her ears receding. Pores visible across her nose and cheeks through the caked foundation, a single ingrown hair at her jawline. The camera captures this in the flat, slightly noisy digital of budget reality production — the sensor grain most visible in the magenta shadows behind her. The booth feels claustrophobic, intimate, and extractive — a confession machine designed to convert private feeling into content.

prompts.title: Morning Show Sunrise
prompts.subject: two young adults
prompts.text: A wide shot of two young adults — a man and a woman — on a bright morning show sofa, an L-shaped piece upholstered in a neutral fabric that shows the indentation of the previous segment's guest in the middle cushion. She wears a fitted coral dress with cap sleeves, the fabric pulling slightly at the left underarm where the concealed microphone pack is clipped, and nude pumps — one heel showing a scuff from the walk across the studio floor. He wears a slim blue suit with no tie and brown loafers, the suit jacket unbuttoned, his undershirt visible through the white dress shirt where the studio lights are strongest. Both hold branded coffee mugs — his with a faint lipstick mark from a previous user that wasn't caught by props — and face the camera with matching warm professional smiles that don't quite reach the muscles around their eyes at six in the morning. The set is aggressively cheerful: a faux window behind them showing a digital sunrise cityscape — a few pixels dead in the lower corner of the LED screen — fresh flowers on a glass coffee table beginning to wilt, a bookshelf with color-coordinated spines that are all turned backward to hide their titles. Warm wood flooring with cable channels running beneath. The lighting is bright and multi-source — soft key lights from several angles eliminating all shadows, supplemented by a warm gel on the background to simulate golden hour, creating the paradox of shadowless warmth. Foundation is visible on both their collars. The palette is aggressively optimistic: coral, sky blue, warm wood, fresh white. The mood is the performed domestic warmth of morning television — two people working hard to simulate the easy friendship that comes naturally to nobody at dawn.

prompts.title: 70s Quiz Isolation Booth
prompts.subject: a young woman
prompts.text: A straight-on medium shot through a 1970s tube camera of a young woman inside a transparent isolation booth — phone-booth-sized glass enclosure with a domed top, the glass panels showing smudges from previous contestants' palms and a hairline crack in the lower-left corner sealed with clear tape. Padded headphones clamp over her ears, the vinyl pads compressing her hair, leaving a visible indentation on her cheeks. A single suspended microphone at mouth level, its chrome surface tarnished. She wears a fitted ribbed turtleneck in cream — the ribbing stretched at the elbows — and a plaid skirt in brown and orange, her hair in a shag cut with feathered bangs matted slightly with perspiration under the booth's sealed heat. Her eyes are closed in concentration, lips moving silently, a vein visible at her temple. Outside the booth, the game show set is visible through the glass: a host at a podium shuffling question cards, a scoreboard with mechanical flip numbers — one number stuck between two digits — and the edge of a studio audience. The glass reflects the studio lights, creating ghostly overlapping reflections on her face that the tube camera smears into soft haloes. Tube characteristics are pronounced: the glass booth's highlights bloom heavily into white ghosts, her cream turtleneck glows with chroma lag, interlace lines are visible through the transparent surfaces creating a moiré with the booth's metal frame, and the warm amber cast softens everything into a honeyed fog. The perspiration on her upper lip catches the overhead light. The mood is suspenseful intimacy — a mind working under observation, the glass booth turning intellect into spectacle while the Plumbicon tube dissolves the boundary between subject and set.

prompts.title: Soap Opera Hospital
prompts.subject: a young man
prompts.text: A medium close-up of a young man in a hospital bed on a soap opera set — the bed's sheets crisp but the pillow shows a head-shaped indent from rehearsals. He wears a hospital gown that's been subtly tailored: darts at the shoulders, a slightly open neckline revealing precisely the right amount of collarbone, the ties at the back hidden by his posture. The makeup department's bruises are convincing: a purple-yellow contusion on his cheekbone applied with sponge stipple, visible texture in the makeup if you look close enough, and a small picturesque bandage on his forehead — the adhesive edges lifting slightly from the heat of the lights. An IV drip stand beside him with a bag that catches the key light, the tube clipped to the gown but clearly not inserted. Despite the medical setting, his hair is immaculately styled with product — a deliberate contradiction — and his five o'clock shadow is trimmed to the millimeter, each hair the same length. His skin shows the sheen of moisturizer beneath the foundation, natural pores visible along his nose. He gazes toward a doorway at frame edge with wounded longing, the tendons in his jaw working — his eyes genuinely wet, whether from glycerin or craft. The set: a heart monitor displaying a steady green line — the screen's refresh rate creating a faint horizontal band in the camera — generic floral arrangements on a side table with a get-well card propped open, venetian blinds casting striped shadows across the bed and his face, one blind slat slightly bent. A partially open door reveals a hallway — a passing nurse silhouette. The lighting is warm: window-side key through the blinds creating atmospheric stripes, fill from a practical overhead fixture that buzzes faintly. The palette is institutional warmth: pale green, white linen, warm skin, the cold green of the monitor against the yellow of wilting flowers.

prompts.title: 70s Pyramid Clue
prompts.subject: a young man
prompts.text: A tight medium shot on a 1970s tube camera of a young man seated in a triangular contestant booth — part of a pyramid-shaped game show set — leaning forward with kinetic energy, his mouth open mid-word showing a slightly crooked bottom tooth, one hand making a rapid circular gesture so fast it blurs in the tube camera's slow scan. He wears a light blue leisure jacket with wide lapels — the polyester catching the overhead lights in a flat sheen — over a patterned knit shirt in geometric brown-and-cream that creates a subtle moiré pattern with the tube's interlace lines, and tinted amber glasses that produce paired specular flares from the two studio key lights. The triangular booth frame around him is covered in gold-foil laminate, dented at one corner, with embedded chase lights running along the edges — three bulbs dead in sequence creating a gap in the animation. Behind and above, the larger pyramid structure rises with illuminated segments in green, amber, and red — the red segment casting a warm wash on his face that the tube camera amplifies into a full orange cast. A digital clock display counts down in large red LED numerals that smear vertically in the pickup tube's characteristic lag, the colon between minutes and seconds blinking in visible steps. Perspiration at his temples catches the overhead light. His tinted glasses produce double-specular reflections, interlace lines pattern the entire frame, and the warm amber color cast merges with the gold set into a unified gilded tone. Flat overhead studio wash with a slight hot spot on his forehead. The mood is kinetic panic — language reduced to one-word bursts, the clock smearing, the body leaning forward as if speed alone could bridge the gap between thought and voice.

prompts.title: Telenovela Garden Scheme
prompts.subject: two young women
prompts.text: A medium two-shot of two young women in a telenovela garden set — a courtyard with a stone fountain whose pump creates a thin, slightly uneven stream, climbing roses on an iron trellis with a few brown-edged petals caught in the lower frame, and a wrought-iron bench with flaking paint. The woman in white — a pristine linen suit, already creased at the elbows, pearl earrings catching the filtered light — stands with arms crossed, her chin raised, one foot slightly advanced as if ready to close distance. The skin at her knuckles is white from the pressure of her grip on her own arm. The other woman, in a form-fitting deep red dress with a high slit revealing a tan line at the thigh, leans against the fountain edge, filing her nails with deliberate nonchalance — fine nail dust visible on the stone ledge — a smirk pulling at one corner of her mouth, the lip liner slightly darker than her lipstick. The tension between them is physical — their bodies angled like two points of a triangle whose third point is the unspoken secret. Dappled warm sunlight through an overhead vine canopy creates moving leaf shadows on their faces and the stone surfaces; a hidden backlight gives the fountain water a golden sparkle. The garden floor shows scattered petals and a few cigarette butts from the crew's break. The palette is classic telenovela contrast: pure white versus dangerous red, green garden, warm stone, golden light. A slight dolly movement is implied by perspective shift. The mood is coiled — two women holding weapons disguised as words, every manicured detail a calculated choice.

prompts.title: Talent Show Spotlight
prompts.subject: a young woman
prompts.text: A wide shot of a young woman standing alone at the center of a dark, empty talent show stage, a single follow-spot creating a harsh circular pool of warm white light around her — the pool's edge sharp as a blade where it meets the dark stage floor, dust motes drifting through the beam. She wears a simple black dress — the jersey fabric showing a pull near the hip, the tag just visible at the back neckline — with bare feet on the cold stage floor, her toes slightly curled against the surface. Her arms hang at her sides, fingers slightly curled, chin lifted, eyes closed, the lids trembling almost imperceptibly. The tendons in her neck are visible. A single droplet of sweat traces from her hairline to her jaw. This is the breath before the first note — the held moment where the body organizes itself for sound. The stage beyond the spot is vast darkness: black velvet curtains with a faint vertical crease from storage, three empty judges' chairs at stage foot with small desk lamps creating warm amber pools on their scoring tables — a pen uncapped, a water glass half-empty. The silent audience area is suggested by rows of seats fading into complete darkness, a few phone screens glowing like distant blue stars. The follow-spot is the only light: inside the circle, every texture is hyper-visible — the knit of the dress, the pores on her forearms, the fine hairs at her temple; outside it, nothing exists. Her shadow stretches long behind her, touching the curtain. The palette is stripped: warm spotlight gold on black void, skin, matte black jersey. The moment is raw with anticipation — the most visible a person can be, wearing the least a performer can wear, standing in light surrounded by nothing.

prompts.title: 70s Newlywed Sofa
prompts.subject: a young couple
prompts.text: A medium-wide shot on a 1970s tube camera of a young couple on an overstuffed sofa upholstered in a bold brown-and-orange geometric pattern — the pattern creating an aggressive moiré with the interlace scan lines, the upholstery pilling at the arm where guests have rubbed it through a full season. He wears a cream turtleneck with a small moth hole near the cuff and a brown corduroy blazer, the wales catching light in alternating bright and dark stripes; she wears a floral maxi dress in rust and gold with bell sleeves, the left sleeve bunched where her microphone wire runs inside. They sit close — his arm draped across the sofa back behind her, the fingers of his hand visible near her far shoulder with bitten nails — both holding small answer paddles in their laps, the paddles' white surfaces showing previous contestants' marker bleed-through. Their expressions mix nervous amusement and conspiratorial glances — she's just nudged his foot with hers, and his lips are pressed together suppressing a laugh while her eyes widen slightly in feigned innocence. The set: a raised host platform at frame right with a scoreboard whose mechanical number tiles are mismatched — some white, some cream — and a decorative macramé partition behind the sofa that has come undone at one tassel. The studio backdrop is burnt sienna. Tube camera artifacts dominate: the geometric upholstery moirés violently with the scan lines, highlights on the answer paddles bloom, warm amber cast is total, and the couple's skin is smoothed into a golden uniformity that erases detail but adds warmth. The mood is a real marriage performing itself for cameras — the inside joke that nobody else can hear, played for points.

prompts.title: Televangelism Pulpit
prompts.subject: a young man
prompts.text: A low-angle wide shot of a young man at an enormous white podium on a televangelism set — the podium's acrylic surface showing fingerprints where he's been gripping during the emotional peaks. His immaculate white suit, white shirt, white tie — the suit's lapel slightly rumpled from the gestures, the tie loosened a millimeter from the heat, a sweat stain darkening the collar. A gold watch glints at his cuff as one hand rises palm-forward in a gesture of blessing, the vein in his forearm visible from the sustained elevation, the other hand gripping the podium edge with white knuckles. His expression is radiant and intense: eyes wide with something between conviction and performance, a visible pulse at the temple, his forehead glazed with perspiration that catches the overhead spot in a hot white line. Behind him, rows of choir members in matching purple robes on risers — one singer in the back row stifling a yawn, another's robe hem caught in the riser hinge — a white grand piano with a dust line on its closed lid, multiple camera booms visible at the edges with operators in headsets. A massive backlit cross in frosted acrylic dominates the backdrop, its internal fluorescent tubes creating an ethereal glow that lens-flares into a starburst, the acrylic showing a hairline stress fracture in the lower arm. An LED ticker at stage base scrolls a phone number for donations in electric blue — the only cold color in the frame. The lighting is designed to simulate divinity: massive overhead softboxes creating flat, shadow-free illumination on the white suit, theatrical uplighting from below turning the cross into a beacon. The palette is white, gold, purple, and the blue of the ticker. The air shimmers with the heat of the lights. The mood is rapturous and engineered — salvation as broadcast event, faith and production value inseparable.

prompts.title: Kids Show Costume
prompts.subject: a young woman
prompts.text: A medium shot of a young woman on a children's TV show set — a world of oversized foam props: a giant red mushroom whose foam is dented at the cap, a blue mailbox with a crooked flag, a yellow fence with visible hot-glue seams at the joints, and felt-covered trees whose trunks show where the fabric has been reattached with safety pins. She wears a deliberately childlike outfit repurposed as fashion: an oversized striped rugby shirt in red and white, the stripes not quite aligning at the side seam, tucked into a flared denim pinafore with copper buttons, chunky yellow rain boots showing a smear of stage-floor paint on one sole, and a mismatched collection of plastic bead necklaces — one strand knotted where it was repaired. Her hair is in two high pigtails with colorful scrunchies, one sitting lower than the other, wisps escaping at the temples. She holds a large foam letter 'Q' under one arm — the foam showing a compression dent from being stacked in storage — and gestures toward camera with wide encouraging energy, her expression genuine despite the performance, the muscles in her smile reaching her eyes. The set is lit with flat, extremely bright illumination from all angles — shadowless, the characteristic totalitarian cheerfulness of children's programming — revealing every imperfection: the seam where two sections of colored backdrop meet, the tape marks on the floor, the dusty base of the mushroom prop. The palette is pure primary: red, blue, yellow, green. The foam smells like a prop warehouse. The mood is joyful and slightly surreal — an adult in a child's world, committed fully, the sincerity more costume than the costume.

prompts.title: 70s Dance Contest Floor
prompts.subject: a young couple
prompts.text: A wide shot on a 1970s tube camera of a young couple mid-spin on a light-up disco dance floor — translucent acrylic panels in red, blue, white, green that illuminate from below in rhythmic sequence, one panel dark and dead in the upper corner. The woman wears a shimmering gold wrap dress with a plunging neckline, the wrap coming slightly undone at the hip from the centrifugal force of the spin, her hair flying outward in an arc that the tube camera smears into a warm amber streak — individual strands separating at the ends, damp with sweat. One strappy gold sandal has slipped slightly at the heel. The man wears a fitted black shirt open to mid-chest, the chest hair visible and slightly matted, white flared trousers with a crease line breaking above the knee from the dance movements, and patent leather shoes whose surface catches the floor colors in distorted reflections. Their clasped hands — his knuckles white, her ring catching the light — are the anchor point of the spin, visible effort in the muscles of their forearms. The studio set includes a small elevated DJ booth with a mirrored disco ball above — the ball missing a few mirror tiles, the remaining ones throwing fractured reflections that the tube camera explodes into sustained specular streaks across the image. Go-go cages at stage edges, a panel of three judges at a long table, one judge mid-sip from a water glass. The tube camera is overwhelmed: the light-up floor creates massive bloom through the acrylic, interlace lines are pronounced in the darker areas, the gold dress leaves a warm smear wherever it trails, and the overall color temperature oscillates between the floor's changing hues — each color shift registering as a full-frame ambient tint. Sweat is visible on both their necks and arms. The mood is ecstatic and exhausting — bodies in genuine motion, the dance a real physical negotiation captured in degraded video.

prompts.title: Late Night Interview Smoke
prompts.subject: a young woman
prompts.text: A medium shot of a young woman seated in the guest chair on a late-night interview set — a stripped-down, intimate format with a dark background, two facing chairs whose leather shows the cracked patina of a decade of guests, and a small table between them holding an ashtray with two previous butts, a glass of water with a lipstick print on the rim, and another glass untouched. She wears a slouchy oversized charcoal cashmere blazer over nothing — the fabric draping to reveal her collarbone, the ridge of which catches the warm key light, a small mole visible on the left clavicle. Dark tailored trousers, pointed boots with a scratch on the toe cap. Her hair is tousled in an artfully undone way that probably took forty minutes. A lit cigarette trails a thin line of smoke from her fingers resting on the chair arm, the smoke column caught perfectly by the amber desk lamp light, spiraling upward before breaking apart in the studio's air conditioning current. Her expression is wry and guarded — mid-answer, looking at an off-screen interviewer with the half-smile of someone choosing their words very carefully, the muscles around her eyes slightly tightened, a slight forward lean suggesting she's about to contradict herself. The set lighting is atmospheric: a single warm key from the side carving deep shadow across one half of her face — the shadow side showing the natural texture of her skin, pores, the faint line of a vein at her temple — a subtle blue backlight on the dark backdrop, and the practical amber desk lamp catching the smoke in a visible column. The palette is noir: charcoal, warm amber, cool blue, smoke gray. Shallow depth of field softens the background into color and suggestion. The mood is an interview at the hour when the performance starts to crack — fashion as armor in a space designed for confession.

prompts.title: 70s Match Game Panel
prompts.subject: a young woman
prompts.text: A medium shot on a 1970s tube camera of a young woman at the end of a long celebrity panel desk — white laminate surface with coffee ring stains and marker bleed-through from previous tapings, individual microphones on gooseneck stands bent to various heights, name plaques in plastic holders. She occupies the last seat, slightly isolated from the other empty chairs — some pushed back at angles from the last segment. She wears a wrap-around printed blouse in large orange and brown floral patterns, the fabric pulling at the wrap tie where it's been re-knotted between takes, a denim skirt, and cork platform wedges visible beneath the desk — one shoe slightly off, the cork showing a crack at the heel. She holds a marker pen with the cap between her teeth and an oversized answer card, caught mid-laugh with her head thrown back, mouth open wide enough to show a silver filling, one hand slapping the desk surface hard enough to make the microphone bounce in its stand. A strand of hair is stuck to her lip gloss. The set behind features a large game show logo in rounded 70s typeface with integrated light bulbs — two burned out — a contestant area at stage left with smaller podiums, and a star-shaped backdrop element in metallic gold whose adhesive is visible at the corner. Tube camera rendering: the gold star produces sustained highlight bloom, the overhead lights cast a uniform amber wash, interlace lines pattern the white desk surface, her printed blouse shows color fringing at the high-contrast floral edges. Warm, casual, slightly out of focus. The mood is loose and unscripted — the moment between the written joke and the genuine laugh, caught in degraded analog.

prompts.title: Infomercial Demo
prompts.subject: a young man
prompts.text: A straight-on medium shot of a young man behind a white demonstration table on an infomercial set at what feels like three in the morning — his fitted black mock-neck sweater pushed to the elbows showing forearm hair and a fading tan line from a watch he's not wearing, dark jeans with a wrinkle behind the knee from standing for hours, and a wireless headset microphone wrapped around one ear with the foam windscreen slightly compressed. His expression is exaggerated amazement — eyebrows raised high enough to crease his forehead into three distinct lines, mouth forming an 'O' of wonder — but his eyes tell a different story: slightly bloodshot, the lids heavy, a faint shadow beneath them that the flat lighting can't hide. He holds up a mysterious chrome device with one hand, the device reflecting the overhead fluorescents in a hard white stripe, while the other hand gestures emphatically — fingers splayed, a hangnail visible on the thumb. The demonstration table is cluttered: a messy before-pile on one side — tangled items, one knocked off the table edge and dangling — and a pristine organized result on the other, both slightly skewed from repeated demonstrations. The set is sparse: a plain gray backdrop with a large screen behind showing a product graphic and a "CALL NOW" banner in urgent red with a phone number, a countdown graphic in the corner showing 4:37 remaining. The lighting is flat overhead fluorescents with no fill and no mercy — every pore on his nose, every thread on the sweater, the dust on the chrome device, all rendered in clinical detail. A small scuff mark on the demonstration table's white surface. The palette is institutional: gray, white, black, chrome, with only the red "CALL NOW" text providing color. The mood is the strange alchemy of late-night television — a man performing enthusiasm past the point of exhaustion, the product gleaming under lights that illuminate everything and flatter nothing.

prompts.title: 60s — Mothership Priestess
prompts.subject: a young woman
prompts.text: A wide anamorphic shot in the visual language of Geoffrey Unsworth's work on 2001 — front-projected starfield behind a young woman standing at the center of a vast circular chamber, the floor a seamless white that curves upward at the edges into the walls, erasing all spatial reference. She wears a floor-length white gown with a stiff architectural collar rising behind her head like a halo, the fabric catching the overhead practicals in a cool, flat sheen that reads as Eastmancolor stock pushed one stop — the whites slightly chalky, the shadows tipping into a cyan-green cast. Her skin is lit by a single broad soft source from below and slightly forward, filling the shadows under her brow and chin with an unnatural luminosity that makes her appear lit from within. Visible pores along her nose, a faint vein at her temple, the fine hairs on her forearm catching the rim light. The chamber floor shows scuff marks from crew footwear, the curved walls revealing a seam where two flats meet. Her hair is cropped short and severe, plastered to her skull with visible product, reflecting the set lights in two bright bands. The anamorphic lens stretches the chamber laterally, producing subtle barrel distortion at the frame edges and the characteristic oval bokeh in the distant practicals. Film grain is fine and uniform — the controlled grain of large-format 65mm negative — with the faintest gate weave visible as a micro-tremor in the starfield projection. The palette is monochrome future: white, silver, the warm ivory of skin, cool cyan shadows. The mood channels the existential stillness of late-60s cerebral science fiction — the human body as the only organic element in a geometry of pure idea.

prompts.title: 60s — Barbarella Lounge
prompts.subject: a young woman
prompts.text: A medium shot through a vintage Panavision anamorphic lens — horizontal flares streaking across the frame from a cluster of colored practicals embedded in a fur-lined cockpit interior. A young woman reclines on a curved chaise upholstered in white shag, her legs folded beneath her, wearing a metallic silver bodysuit that leaves her arms bare, the fabric wrinkling at the hip where the zipper pulls. Thigh-high boots in glossy patent leather, one boot showing a crease line across the ankle from the reclined pose. The cockpit set is deliriously 60s: bubble-shaped portholes showing rear-projected star fields, control panels made of painted wood with oversized toggle switches and blinking incandescent bulbs, walls lined in tufted vinyl that's started to separate at one seam. Her makeup is period-extreme: frosted blue eyeshadow applied past the crease onto the brow bone, thick false lashes casting spidery shadows, pale pink lipstick with visible lip liner a shade darker. Her skin under the practical lights shows a warm golden cast from the Eastmancolor stock, grain visible in the shadow areas of the cockpit interior, the film's limited latitude crushing the darks into a muddy amber while the highlights on her metallic suit bloom into hot silver. A lens flare from the brightest porthole streaks horizontally across her collarbone. The palette is psychedelic space: metallic silver, white shag, colored practicals in amber and rose, the muddy darks of 60s color negative.

prompts.title: 60s — Planet Surface Scout
prompts.subject: a young man
prompts.text: A wide shot on Eastmancolor stock in the style of Ted Moore's Bond-era cinematography applied to science fiction — a young man standing on a rocky alien landscape, the terrain clearly a quarry dressed with painted foam boulders and raked red sand, a matte painting of twin suns and a green sky visible at the horizon line where the blend with the practical set is almost but not quite seamless. He wears a fitted silver jumpsuit with a mandarin collar and diagonal zip, the nylon fabric catching light in broad, flat reflections, black utility boots with visible sole tread caked in the red sand, and a holster belt with a chrome prop pistol whose barrel shows the seam line of the casting mold. His face is sunburned — genuine redness across the nose and cheekbones that the makeup department has tried to powder down, the powder settling visibly in his pores. Sweat at his temples, matting the hair at the sideburns. The Eastmancolor stock renders the reds hot and slightly oversaturated while the greens in the sky painting shift toward teal — the stock's known instability in the green channel. Film grain is moderate, most visible in the sky matte where the two film elements stack their grain patterns. The palette is pulp sci-fi: silver suit, red sand, green sky, warm skin.

prompts.title: 60s — Control Room Commander
prompts.subject: a young woman
prompts.text: A medium close-up through a spherical 60s lens — no anamorphic squeeze, just the characteristic warm softness of uncoated glass elements. A young woman stands at a curved control console, her hand resting on a bank of illuminated switches, each toggle capped with a different colored jewel — red, amber, green — that glow from within and produce tiny specular flares in the uncoated lens. She wears a high-collared tunic in deep midnight blue, the fabric a heavy wool blend that shows every crease and fold with sculptural weight, a silver insignia pinned at the collar whose casting shows file marks at the edge, and fitted trousers tucked into low boots. Her hair is in a severe chignon, a few strands escaping at the nape of her neck, damp with perspiration from the set lights. The console behind her is a masterwork of 60s prop design: Plexiglas panels backlit with colored gels, oscilloscope screens showing actual Lissajous patterns, reel-to-reel tape drives spinning with visible magnetic tape, and hand-labeled switches in Letraset type. Grain is medium-fine with the characteristic Metrocolor tendency toward warm midtones and slightly blocked-up shadows. Her skin shows visible texture — the powder on her T-zone, the natural warmth of her ears, a tiny mole beneath her left eye.

prompts.title: 60s — Mod Witch Forest
prompts.subject: a young woman
prompts.text: A wide shot in the style of Freddie Young's late-60s Panavision work — a young woman standing in a genuine forest clearing at magic hour, the last amber light filtering horizontally through birch trunks and catching the mist from a fog machine hidden behind the fallen log at frame left. She wears a mod-inspired witch costume: a black velvet mini dress with bell sleeves that absorb light absolutely, white knee-high go-go boots muddied at the soles from the forest floor, and a wide silver pendant on a chain that swings slightly. Her hair is long and straight, center-parted, slightly tangled from the wind machine. Her eyes are lined in heavy black Cleopatra style, the kohl slightly smudged from the humidity. Her skin catches the golden hour light with subsurface warmth, goosebumps on her bare arms from the evening chill. Shot on 70mm Panavision — the 65mm negative producing extraordinarily fine grain with rich tonal separation. The palette is fairy tale naturalism: black velvet, birch silver, amber light, forest green, mud brown.

prompts.title: 70s — Corridor Pressure Suit
prompts.subject: a young woman
prompts.text: A medium shot down a cramped spacecraft corridor in the visual register of Derek Vanlint's Alien — overhead fluorescent tubes casting a flat, slightly green-tinged industrial light through plastic diffusers, one tube flickering with a dying ballast, the walls a maze of ribbed conduit and junction boxes with hand-stenciled warning labels. A young woman moves through the corridor in a bulky pressure suit — off-white fabric with heavy ring seals at the wrists, the suit's surface showing scuff marks on the knees, a darkened patch at the hip from leaning against consoles, a small tear repaired with adhesive patch tape. The helmet removed, held under one arm, revealing matted hair pressed flat from the liner, sweat-darkened at the temples. Her face flushed and puffy from the suit's heat, perspiration on her upper lip, redness at the nose bridge from the helmet's pressure ring. The corridor floor is metal grating through which lower-level vapor is visible. Shot on Kodak 5247 pushed one stop — the grain blooms in shadow areas, fluorescent light reads as sickly chartreuse-green, anamorphic lens produces oval bokeh and horizontal flare. The palette is industrial anxiety: dirty white, pipe gray, fluorescent green, warm skin.

prompts.title: 70s — Desert Nomad Dune
prompts.subject: a young man
prompts.text: A wide shot in the parched style of Vilmos Zsigmond's naturalistic approach transplanted to an alien world. A young man crosses a vast dune field, shot with a long telephoto lens compressing the ridges into abstract waves of ochre and shadow. He wears layered desert robes — heavy linen outer cloak in faded sienna showing salt stains, leather gauntlets cracked by sun, wrapped boots coming loose at the left ankle. A rebreather apparatus at his neck — chrome and rubber with visible screws. His face is weathered by actual sun — sunburn peeling on the nose, sand in his eyebrows and stubble, lips chapped and split. The Kodak 5247 renders the desert warm — oranges singing, blue sky burning to white at the zenith. Grain is coarse and visible in the bright sand, telephoto compression stacking atmospheric haze into a visible amber filter of suspended dust. Anamorphic breathing produces gentle bokeh pulsing. The palette is elemental: sand ochre, sky white, skin leather, cloth sienna.

prompts.title: 70s — Telekinesis Lab
prompts.subject: a young woman
prompts.text: A tight close-up in the visual language of John Alcott's cold, precise work for Kubrick — a young woman's face filling the anamorphic frame, lit by a single hard source from directly above that turns her eye sockets into deep shadow pools while her cheekbones blaze with overexposed brilliance. She's in a clinical laboratory, a stainless steel headrest behind her skull, a monitoring electrode taped to her temple with its wire trailing. Her expression is extreme concentration bordering on pain — jaw clenched, a vein at her temple, pupils dilated to nearly swallow the iris. A thread of blood from her left nostril to her upper lip, catching the light in a wet specular line. Her skin is bare of makeup — every pore, fine hair, micro-blemish rendered with merciless clarity. She wears a pale green hospital gown, plastic patient bracelet on the wrist, fingers gripping the chair arm with white knuckles. Shot on Kodak 5247 — low-key, hard-edged, no fill. Grain is fine but crystalline. The palette is clinical-cold: stainless steel, pale green, blood and skin against institutional surfaces.

prompts.title: 70s — Giallo Android
prompts.subject: a young woman
prompts.text: A medium shot drenched in the saturated lighting of Mario Bava and Luciano Tovoli — a young woman standing in a doorway between two violently colored spaces: the room behind flooded with arterial red, the corridor ahead washed in cold cobalt blue. Her face split down the center — one half red, one half blue — the colors mixing to bruised violet on her nose bridge. She wears a white lab coat over a black turtleneck, the coat thin enough that the black shows through at the shoulders. Her hair is wet, slicked back, dripping onto the collar where a damp stain spreads. One hand holds a chrome surgical instrument catching both lights in split reflections. Walls are institutional tile with cracked grouted seams, lower sections stained dark. Shot on Fuji stock — warmer than Kodak, reds more orange, blues more electric, grain coarser. Bava-style lighting creates absolute color zones with no graduation. The palette is chromo-horror: red, blue, violet, white coat, skin warmth.

prompts.title: 70s — Dystopia Market
prompts.subject: a young man
prompts.text: A wide shot through a vintage Panavision C-series anamorphic — warm, soft images with pronounced breathing and blue-streak flares. A young man pushes through a crowded underground market carved from concrete infrastructure — arched ceilings with exposed rebar, stalls cobbled from corrugated metal and salvaged electronics. He wears a leather jacket patched with mismatched hides — some smooth, some suede, some cracked — over a thermal undershirt with a hole at the collar, canvas trousers with knee reinforcements worn through. Military surplus boots with laces replaced by wire. His face shows days of stubble, dark circles, a healed scar across one eyebrow. The market crowd is dense, extras in layered dirty clothing. Practicals are bare swaying incandescent bulbs and decaying fluorescents, creating unstable flickering light. Shot on Kodak 5254 — heavy grain, most visible in deep shadows, smoke haze adding texture. Blue-white anamorphic flares from every practical. The palette is scavenger warm: leather brown, concrete gray, bare-bulb amber.

prompts.title: 70s — Space Truckers Mess
prompts.subject: two young adults
prompts.text: A medium two-shot in a cramped spacecraft mess hall — camera at table level across aluminum trays and condensation-beaded drink containers. Two young adults sit opposite: a man in a stained undershirt with maritime tattoos, blurred ink from age; a woman in a flight suit unzipped to the waist, ribbed tank beneath, cigarette burning, smoke curling toward the ceiling vent. The mess is used-future: Formica surfaces with burn marks and carved initials, overhead strip lighting with one mismatched replacement tube, a coffee machine with scale buildup, bulletin board with pinned photos. Both faces show fatigue — her eyes puffy and bloodshot, his jaw slack. Shot on Kodak 5247 with practical lighting only — flat institutional overhead plus the warm amber of the coffee machine's pilot light. Grain is moderate and organic. The palette is working blue-collar: institutional beige, stained aluminum, warm skin, cigarette gray.

prompts.title: 60s — Crystal Cave Oracle
prompts.subject: a young woman
prompts.text: A low-angle medium shot lit entirely by colored practicals hidden within prop crystal formations — a young woman kneeling surrounded by enormous translucent crystals, each lit from within by different gels: amber, rose, pale green. She wears a flowing sheer gown pooling on the cave floor, a hammered metal circlet on her forehead showing tool marks. Her eyes closed, hands raised palm-upward, face tilted toward the crystal light that paints it in shifting patches. Her skin shows real texture under practicals alone — the amber making her warm, the rose highlighting flush, the green making wrist veins visible. The cave floor is genuine rough stone, her bare feet dirty, the gown's hem torn on rock. Condensation drips from the ceiling, one drop visible mid-fall catching light. Shot on 65mm stock — near-grainless with extraordinary depth and tonal range. The palette is elemental: crystal amber, rose, green, stone gray, skin warmth, absolute cave black.

prompts.title: 70s — Bridge Standoff
prompts.subject: a young man
prompts.text: A tight over-the-shoulder shot — a young man facing a viewport filled with a slow-approaching planet, a gorgeous matte painting on glass with painted clouds casting shadows on continents. Seen from behind and three-quarter profile — neck tendons taut, jaw muscle pulsing, hand gripping the captain's chair hard enough to compress the vinyl. He wears a dark military uniform jacket with band collar, the fabric heavy, shoulders slightly too broad — a costume built for authority. His hair reveals a nick from a recent haircut behind his right ear, a thin line of dry blood. The bridge: a curved console arc with backlit panel inserts, a few toggles in wrong position from the last take, overhead lighting pooling on consoles while the ceiling stays dark. The viewport frame shows rivets and a stress fracture. Shot on Kodak 5247, channeling John Alcott — hard, precise, no fill. Fine grain, the viewport's brightness forcing the figure into near-silhouette. The palette is command blue: dark navy, console cyan, viewport white, warm skin and blood.

prompts.title: 80s — Neon Rain Runner
prompts.subject: a young woman
prompts.text: A medium shot in Jordan Cronenweth's Blade Runner DNA — night rain falling through colored light from towering video billboards, each raindrop becoming a momentary prism. A young woman at a food stall, steam rising between her and the camera. She wears a long transparent raincoat over a fitted dark dress, the PVC catching every neon in distorted rainbow smears, water beading in clusters the anamorphic lens renders as oval specular highlights. Hair wet and plastered to her face, makeup running — eyeliner tracing dark from the outer corner toward her jaw, lip color faded to stain. The food stall: Asian signage, exposed woks, paper lanterns. Shot on Kodak 5293 — grain aggressive in every shadow, neon colors pushing saturation limits. Cronenweth's signature: smoke, rain, backlight from every source creating halos. The palette is nocturnal chromatic: cyan neon, amber food-stall, red billboard, wet skin warmth.

prompts.title: 80s — Practical Monster
prompts.subject: a young woman
prompts.text: A tight close-up in Dean Cundey's The Thing style — a young woman's face filling the frame, lit from below by a work light on the floor, the uplight creating monstrous shadows. She stares at something below frame reflected in her sweat and dilated pupils. She wears a quilted arctic parka unzipped, fur-lined hood pushed back, frost crystals where breath has condensed on the fabric. Her skin raw from cold — redness at nose and cheeks, chapped lips cracked and slightly bleeding, condensation on her eyelashes. Behind her, the corridor stretches into darkness, fluorescents providing faint sickly fill. Something glistens on the linoleum — a wet track of indeterminate origin catching the work light. Shot on Kodak 5247 with practical sources only — darkness genuinely dark. Grain moderate and warm, the stock's limited latitude splitting the harsh close-up from the impenetrable corridor. The palette is isolation: parka blue, frost white, skin pink-red, amber work light, absolute black.

prompts.title: 80s — Synth Wave Club
prompts.subject: a young man
prompts.text: A medium shot in Andrew Laszlo's neon-soaked Streets of Fire aesthetic. A young man at a bar, body angled away, face turned back with calculated indifference. Black leather motorcycle jacket — genuinely worn, creased at elbows, scrape on left shoulder — over a gray-washed white t-shirt, tight black jeans, pointed boots with scratched silver toe caps. Hair slicked back with visible gel catching neon in wet highlights. Cigarette at his lips, smoke rising as a luminous veil in the blue backlight. The bar: neon tube signs in pink and blue reflected in a mirrored back wall, bottles catching colored light, wet surface with condensation rings. Haze fills the middle distance, neon scattering through it into volumetric beams. Shot on Kodak 5293 pushed one stop — heavy churning grain, neon colors oversaturated to bleeding, blacks crushed to velvet. Blue and pink flares streak through the anamorphic frame. The palette is noir-neon: black leather, pink and blue neon, chrome, smoke, cigarette ember warmth.

prompts.title: 60s — Hex Corridor Escape
prompts.subject: a young woman
prompts.text: A tracking shot frozen mid-movement — camera low in a hexagonal corridor, honeycomb panels receding in forced perspective toward a vanishing point of white light. A young woman runs toward camera mid-stride, one boot lifted, body pitched forward in genuine momentum. She wears a silver lame tunic bunching at the waist from the run, white tights with a visible ladder at the knee, silver ankle boots with a separating heel. Her hair streams behind — the wind machine visible as a shadow on the left wall. Her face shows real exertion: mouth open, nostrils flared, perspiration at the hairline. Each hexagonal panel is individually backlit, some brighter where gels have shifted, the polished floor reflecting her running figure in a dark mirror. At the far end, the white light overexposes the Metrocolor stock, bloom eating into the walls. Shot with a wide-angle lens exaggerating the corridor's perspective. Grain is medium with Metrocolor's warm midtone bias. The palette is monochrome sci-fi: silver, white, the warm anomaly of sweat and skin.

prompts.title: 70s — Soylent Crowd
prompts.subject: a young man
prompts.text: A wide shot through a dirty telephoto — actual dust and thumbprint on the front element softening the image. A young man at the edge of a massive crowd on a brutalist street, shot from high angle compressing bodies into an abstract pattern. He wears a worn corduroy jacket in faded mustard, elbow patches frayed, ribbed turtleneck, heavy denim with visible mending. His face turned upward — hollowed cheeks, patchy stubble, narrowed eyes, a cut on his lower lip sealed with dried blood. The crowd in similar earth-toned layers. The street: concrete housing blocks with water staining, windows covered with improvised shields. Shot on Kodak 5254 — heavy organic grain giving a newsreel texture, overcast light rendering everything in flat, desaturated olive, mustard, concrete gray. The dirty lens adds overall haze. The palette is 70s dystopia: mustard, concrete, olive drab, warm exhausted skin.

prompts.title: 80s — Terminator Garage
prompts.subject: a young man
prompts.text: A low-angle medium shot in Adam Greenberg's Terminator register — a young man shirtless in a concrete parking garage, lit by a sodium vapor fixture creating strong warm backlight that rims his shoulders while his face falls into cool shadow broken by the wet concrete floor's reflected glow. His torso shows real physicality — visible muscle but also natural asymmetries, a scar on his ribs, sweat running in defined tracks catching the backlight. Military tactical trousers, one boot laced and one unlaced, holster rig over bare skin leaving red compression marks. His face: grim determination, a fresh abrasion on his cheekbone showing real bruise colors of purple and yellow. The garage extends in brutal geometry: concrete pillars, yellow arrows, a distant red EXIT sign. Shot on Kodak 5293 — heavy grain in shadows, sodium light as vivid amber-orange, cool shadows going deep blue-steel. Anamorphic blue flares from the sodium fixture. The palette is hard chrome: concrete gray, sodium amber, steel blue, skin warmth, blood purple.

prompts.title: 80s — Cyber Geisha District
prompts.subject: a young woman
prompts.text: A medium shot in Blade Runner's Chinatown visual density — Jordan Cronenweth's commitment to atmospheric depth. A young woman pauses at a noodle shop threshold, steam pouring out. She wears a structured oxblood leather jacket darkened by rain in uneven patches, over a high-necked mesh top showing her collarbones. A transparent umbrella closed against her leg. Her makeup deliberate: white foundation with visible brush strokes at the jaw, vermillion lips, extended black eye liner with surgical precision. Actual skin showing through foundation at the temples where she's rubbed it. The alley behind: a vertical canyon of illuminated signage — Japanese, Chinese, Korean characters in neon, light multiplied by rain-wet surfaces. Paper lanterns sway. Shot on Kodak 5293 — heavy visible grain, neon pushing past comfortable saturation, rain visible as silver streaks in backlit beams. Anamorphic flares from every source. The palette is Cronenweth-noir: oxblood, neon cyan, vermillion, amber, rain silver, deep shadow.

prompts.title: 60s — Space Lounge Hostess
prompts.subject: a young woman
prompts.text: A medium shot in Douglas Slocombe's vivid 60s color style — a young woman behind a curved fiberglass service bar with integrated lighting strips in a spacecraft lounge. She wears a fitted vivid orange mini-dress — the dye perfectly uniform as only 60s synthetics achieved — with a white belt and pillbox hat pinned with a visible hairpin. White go-go boots with a black mark from the floor. She holds a chrome tray with tulip glasses of obviously food-colored blue water. Her expression is a perfect 60s service smile — wide, impersonal, eyes not engaged. Foundation thick and matte, visible as texture on her forehead, coverage ending at the jawline in a faint tide mark. The lounge: curved white walls with oval windows showing black space, a sunken conversation pit with orange cushions, backlit ceiling panels — one cracked, sealed with tape. Shot on Eastmancolor — oranges oversaturated, blues shifting cyan, skin tones golden, gentle overall softness. Grain fine and even. The palette is optimistic futurism: orange, white, chrome, blue, golden skin.

prompts.title: 70s — Arkham Corridor
prompts.subject: a young woman
prompts.text: A long shot down an institutional corridor in Gordon Willis's master-of-darkness style applied to a psychiatric facility. A young woman walks away from camera, heavy doors with observation windows on each side. She wears a faded blue hospital robe, belt trailing, bare feet on cold linoleum reflecting overhead fluorescents. Her hair loose and unwashed, separating into oily sections backlit individually. One hand trails along the wall leaving faint marks. The fluorescents are spaced widely, creating alternating pools of light and shadow she walks through in rhythmic visibility. Through one observation window, a faint face pressed against glass, breath fogging it. Floor shows scuff marks from gurney wheels. Shot on Kodak 5247 with Willis's signature underexposure — shadows opaque and absolute while highlights retain warm golden detail. Grain appears in midtones as subliminal texture. The palette is institutional dread: faded blue, linoleum green, fluorescent white, shadow black.

prompts.title: 80s — Mech Pilot Cockpit
prompts.subject: a young woman
prompts.text: A tight close-up through a mech pilot's helmet visor — curved surface producing slight fisheye distortion and internal HUD graphic reflections overlaying her face. A young woman stares forward with extreme focus, lit from below by console instruments and from the sides by green phosphor targeting screens. She wears a scratched-visor flight helmet, a pressure suit visible at the neck ring showing sweat stains and chafing. Her face shows the cockpit's toll: G-force flush, pressure marks from helmet padding leaving red impressions, sweat in her eyebrows, one drop suspended on a lash. Eyes slightly bloodshot, pupils contracted by bright instruments. The cockpit: a claustrophobic space of switches, throttles, green-on-black wireframe screens, one warning light blinking red. Shot on Kodak 5293 — grain heavy especially in the phosphor-green areas, the warm instrument lights and cool screen glow in vivid contrast. The visor creates an optical layer of depth through obstruction. The palette is combat cockpit: helmet gray, phosphor green, instrument amber, warning red, skin flush.

prompts.title: 70s — Witch Commune
prompts.subject: a young woman
prompts.text: A medium shot in the restrained style of Luciano Tovoli — a young woman cross-legged on bare wooden floor in a candlelit room, surrounded by silhouetted figures at frame edges. She wears a plain linen shift in natural undyed fabric, weave visible as coarse grid under candlelight, bare dirty feet, silver ankle chain. Her hair genuinely uncombed, candle's warm light picking out individual gold strands while the mass stays dark. Her face serene but alert, candlelight from below casting dramatic uplight shadows turned gentle by her calm expression. Visible: fine forearm hairs gilt by flame, a shin bruise, rough bare soles. The room: bare cracked plaster walls, water staining, a single window showing blue-hour dusk, wooden floor planks with dust-filled gaps. Candles — the only light. Shot on Fuji stock — warmer than Kodak, candle amber rendered almost orange, shadows going warm chocolate. Grain visible and organic, flickering with the flames. The palette is pre-modern: linen, wood, candle amber, skin gold, dusk blue.

prompts.title: 80s — Tron Grid Walker
prompts.subject: a young man
prompts.text: A wide shot — a young man walking across an infinite black plane marked with a rectilinear grid of luminous cyan lines extending to the horizon. He's the only dimensional element in a flat digital void. He wears a form-fitting black suit with electroluminescent circuit patterns in thin cyan lines from battery packs hidden in the costume, wiring visible at the ankle. His face lit solely by the suit's glow and grid's luminosity — unnatural cyan uplight making features strange, skin gray-blue, lips purple, under-eye circles deepened. The grid floor: luminous tape on black velvet, the camera low to create perspective convergence. Where boots meet grid lines, a subtle practical glow on boot surfaces. Shot on Kodak 5293 with heavy push processing — extreme grain everywhere, black areas alive with dancing silver particles, cyan lines softening at edges into the grain structure. The palette is digital absolute: black, cyan, de-naturalized skin gray-blue.

prompts.title: 60s — Saucer Abductee
prompts.subject: a young woman
prompts.text: A high-angle medium shot looking down into a circular depression in a spacecraft floor lined with quilted silver material, lit from beneath by a slow-cycling practical light shifting amber to white to pale blue. A young woman lies arranged as if placed by non-human hands — arms at sides, palms up, head slightly turned. She wears her own 60s mod dress in pale pink with Peter Pan collar, white stockings, one shoe on and one off — the missing shoe suggesting she was taken mid-step. Her hair fans out on the silver quilting catching the cycling light in shifting colors. Her eyes are open but vacant. Her skin under the changing light reveals different textures with each color phase: pores in amber, fine hairs in white, veins in blue. The Eastmancolor stock responds to the cycling practicals with visible color temperature shifts and grain character changes per phase. Shot from directly above with a wide lens making the circular depression fill the frame. The palette cycles: silver quilting, pink dress, amber/white/blue cycling, adapting skin.

prompts.title: 70s — Logan Sanctuary
prompts.subject: a young woman
prompts.text: A wide anamorphic shot in Ernest Laszlo's saturated 70s style — a young woman standing in a vast geodesic interior, hexagonal glass panels overhead showing a projected sunset in amber and rose. She wears a diaphanous green chiton so sheer her silhouette is visible beneath, gathered at one shoulder with a chrome clasp, hem uneven from cutting. On her palm, a crystal glowing with a practical internal LED. Sandals with chrome ankle straps, one buckle undone. Her skin under the projected sunset uniformly warm, but where light fails — hollows of neck, beneath her arm — ambient blue fluorescent floor shows through, creating cool counterpoint. The geodesic shows construction: visible structural joints, a few darker panels where projector coverage fails, white floor with crew footprints visible in raking light. Shot on Kodak 5247 — projected sunset and fluorescent floor fighting for color temperature dominance. Grain fine, anamorphic breathing on focus pulls. The palette is utopia-warm: amber, rose, pale green, chrome, cool blue undertones.

prompts.title: 80s — Darkened Lab Specimen
prompts.subject: a young woman
prompts.text: A medium shot in Adrian Biddle's cold Aliens lighting — a young woman behind reinforced glass, palms pressed flat, breath fogging the surface in two expanding circles, handprints leaving clear patches through condensation. She wears an oversized white medical smock, collar stained amber, a functional ponytail leaving a visible dent, loose strands catching cold fluorescent light in silver lines. Her face: institutional pallor, dark circles, chapped uncolored lips, surgical tape residue on her inner forearm. Behind the glass: stainless steel surfaces, specimen jars, a monitoring screen with amber characters, a red recording LED. The camera shoots through her breath-fog and handprints from the corridor side. Shot on Kodak 5293 — grain visible in shadows, fluorescent light rendering as cold blue-green with cyan shift. Glass creates secondary reflections — corridor lights as ghosts on her face. The palette is containment cold: white smock, steel blue, fluorescent green, amber monitor, warm breath-fog against cold glass.

prompts.title: 60s — Vampire Castle Gate
prompts.subject: a young woman
prompts.text: A wide shot in Jack Asher's lush Technicolor Hammer Horror style — a young woman before a massive rusted iron gate, partially obscured by ivy wired in place with visible green florist tape. Beyond the gate, a practical castle against a painted cyclorama sky in blue-violet — brush strokes visible at the upper edge. She wears a white cotton nightgown, slightly translucent at the gathered sleeves showing pink skin beneath. Bare feet on gravel, soles dirty, toes curled against cold. A dark cloak draped over one arm, trailing. Hair wind-tousled from the wind machine just out of frame. Her face in simulated moonlight — a blue-gelled arc lamp — drained of warm color, going porcelain with faint blue cast, warmth only at lips and inner eye corners. The gate shows genuine rust, ivy has real leaves, gravel extends into the practical set where the castle model takes over. Shot on Technicolor's three-strip derivative — saturated, hyper-real color making the blue deeper than nature, white brighter than physics. Grain almost absent in the dye transfer. The palette is Gothic primary: blue night, white innocence, rust decay, pink skin.

prompts.title: 80s — Alien Bar Cantina
prompts.subject: a young man
prompts.text: A medium shot in a packed alien bar — camera at table level across a sticky surface marked with glass rings. A young man in a corner booth, back to the wall. He wears a leather flight vest over a henley, pockets stuffed with tools, cargo pants with holster tie-downs, scuffed boots. His face is actually sun-damaged — a deep crease between eyebrows, crow's feet, a white raised scar through one eyebrow. A drink in a grimy metal cup catches the neon. Around him: performers in foam latex prosthetics — mask edges visible at the neck, human eyes blinking within rubber faces, gloved hands whose fingers don't bend right. The bar dressed with military obsessiveness: unknown liquid bottles, an alien cash register, hand-painted alien signage. Smoke machines fill the middle distance with blue haze. Shot on Kodak 5293 with practical lighting only — neon signs, table lights, amber bartender lamp. Grain heavy in smoke, anamorphic flares from every neon. The palette is cantina-noir: leather, neon blue, smoke gray, amber, human skin among prosthetic faces.

prompts.title: 70s — Solaris Station
prompts.subject: a young man
prompts.text: A wide shot of absolute stillness — a young man sitting in a curved modernist chair in a circular room, floor-to-ceiling windows showing a slowly churning alien ocean — colored oils on water, rear-projected, undulating in hypnotic amber and violet patterns. He sits in profile, unmoving, wearing a pale gray collarless shirt and dark trousers, barefoot on white carpet showing chair-leg indentations. His hands rest on his thighs, face in repose but not relaxed — jaw muscle visible, blink rate slower than natural. His reflection in the window overlays the alien ocean — a translucent ghost superimposed on churning surface. The room: the chair, a low table with a single book, a spherical lamp providing warm golden light creating a pocket of warmth against the cool ocean-reflected color. His skin shows a split — warm side lit by the lamp with pores and stubble, cold side lit by the ocean going corpse-gray blue. Shot channeling Vadim Yusov — patient, contemplative, geometric precision. Kodak 5247 renders the dual lighting as vivid warm-cool split. The palette is Tarkovsky-melancholy: gray, warm amber, alien violet-blue, white, skin warmth.

prompts.title: 80s — Neon Swordfight
prompts.subject: a young woman
prompts.text: A dynamic medium shot — a young woman mid-swing with a glowing energy blade, a practical acrylic rod with internal fiber optics producing vivid magenta glow illuminating everything within a meter, including the underside of her chin, the fine hairs on her arm, costume texture. She wears a fitted black bodysuit with angular chrome-sprayed armor plates showing chipping at struck edges, fabric showing stretch marks at joints. Her asymmetric bob whips to one side — strands separated by motion, some matted with sweat against her neck. Her face: teeth bared, eyes tracking target, neck tendons in relief. The blade paints her in magenta-and-shadow against the dark industrial warehouse. Motion blur traces a magenta arc while her body stays sharp. Shot on Kodak 5293 pushed two stops — extreme aggressive grain, magenta pushing into uncharted stock territory, blacks noisy and warm. The anamorphic lens produces dramatic flare from the blade. The palette is 80s action-fantasy: magenta, chrome armor, black, warm sweating skin, distant blue.

prompts.title: 60s — Planet of Exile
prompts.subject: a young man
prompts.text: A wide Panavision shot across an alien landscape — a Mediterranean coastline at golden hour made strange by twin practical suns from aircraft landing lights on a scaffold, burning the sky to flat hot white while the foreground stays in warm directional golden hour light. A young man sits on a rock outcrop facing the double sunset, back to camera, silhouette dark against overexposed sky. He wears remnants of a uniform — silver fabric faded to pale gray, one sleeve torn showing tanned freckled skin, trousers cut to shorts with rough knife edge. Bare feet with black soles, visible calluses. A makeshift staff wrapped in uniform fabric. His hair sun-bleached and damaged, tied back with a cloth strip. His posture: shoulders relaxed, spine curved — a man who has stopped waiting. Shot on 70mm Eastmancolor — near-grainless with extraordinary dynamic range holding both the twin practicals and real sun in luminous detail. The palette is exile-warm: golden rock, burned-white sky, faded gray, tanned weathered skin.

prompts.title: 80s — Cyberpunk Hacker Den
prompts.subject: a young woman
prompts.text: A tight medium shot — a young woman hunched over a custom terminal in a claustrophobic apartment, walls covered in taped-up printouts and circuit diagrams. She wears an oversized men's dress shirt as smock — coffee stains, solder burns — over leggings and bare feet, one foot tucked under her, toes gripping the seat. The terminal: a CRT monitor with scanline texture and slight image burn, the phosphor glow painting her face amber-green, a keyboard with mismatched replacement keys, exposed circuit boards with visible solder joints. Her face: the specific pallor of someone avoiding daylight — luminous green-tinged, eyes reflecting screen text, dark circles she's stopped noticing. A cigarette burns in a bent soda can ashtray. Hair cut short and growing out unevenly. Shot on Kodak 5293 with the CRT as primary light — heavy warm grain, amber-green phosphor dominating, supplemented only by cigarette ember and distant sodium streetlight through taped window panes. The palette is hacker-nocturnal: CRT amber-green, cigarette amber, sodium orange, room shadow blue-black.

prompts.title: 70s — Ark Ship Botanist
prompts.subject: a young woman
prompts.text: A medium shot in a greenhouse dome aboard a generation ship — geodesic struts overhead, stars visible through panels as fixed points. A young woman kneels in actual dark damp soil tending vegetables, dirt under fingernails and in knuckle creases. She wears a coarse natural cotton woven shirt with visible thread count, sleeves pushed above elbows, canvas trousers with soil-darkened knees. Her face calm and absorbed, a smear of dirt where she's pushed hair back with dirty hands. The greenhouse is functional not decorative: tomato plants on wire stakes, drip irrigation from visible tubing, grow-light panels supplementing starlight with warm slightly pink spectrum. The soil is real — the set is an actual greenhouse dressed with sci-fi elements. Shot on Kodak 5247 with practical grow-lights — warm pink-amber mixed with cold blue-white starfield. Grain moderate and organic. The palette is cultivated: soil brown, plant green, warm pink-amber, cotton white, space blue.

prompts.title: 80s — Alien Autopsy
prompts.subject: a young man
prompts.text: A top-down medium shot looking straight down onto a stainless steel table — a young man in surgical scrubs at the table edge, blue nitrile gloves showing stress wrinkles and an iridescent smear. He holds a chrome instrument poised above something organic and unmistakably not human — textured like wet rubber with faint bioluminescent pulse, partially visible at frame edges. His face from directly above: foreshortened, surgical mask pulled down revealing a mouth pressed tight, sweat beading on his forehead in specular points. Scrubs showing industrial weave, V-neck revealing a t-shirt crew-neck, pen in breast pocket. The table: drainage channels and collection ports, functional and industrial. Overhead surgical lamp providing daylight-balanced, shadowless, unforgiving flood. Shot on Kodak 5247 — fine clinical grain, neutral color science. The palette is autopsy-sterile: stainless steel, blue nitrile, green scrubs, sweating skin warmth, iridescent alien tissue.

prompts.title: 70s — Psychic Duel Fog
prompts.subject: two young adults
prompts.text: A wide anamorphic shot through dense theatrical fog — two young adults facing each other in a featureless studio void, floor and walls lost in white opacity. He stands with one arm extended palm-forward in a black turtleneck and dark trousers — a graphic element, ribbing catching light in parallel lines. She faces him with hands at temples, fingers pressing skull, wearing a pale gray jumpsuit nearly invisible against the fog. Between them, fog churns in a pattern suggesting force — deforming around an invisible shape. His face: veins at temple, jaw clenched, a burst capillary in one eye. Hers: serene but for the sweat — droplets on forehead, upper lip, running from hairline past ear. Their skin under fog-diffused light is shadowless — flat illumination making every expression line equally visible. Shot on Kodak 5254 pushed two stops — heavy grain churning in the fog like separate weather, pushed processing flattening contrast into narrow soft range. The palette is reduced: fog white, black, gray, skin warmth, blood-vessel red.

prompts.title: 60s — Atomic Garden Party
prompts.subject: a young woman
prompts.text: A wide shot of unsettling 60s normalcy — a young woman on a manicured lawn at a garden party, shot through a house window with mullions dividing the image into a grid. She wears a yellow sundress, white elbow gloves, a wide hat casting shadow hiding her eyes, low heels. She holds a champagne glass. The garden party: guests in precise 60s attire — but rising above the tree line, an enormous mushroom cloud, a practical controlled smoke charge photographed through forced perspective. Nobody is looking at it. The lighting is golden diffused afternoon — warm, gentle, safe. Her skin is warm and healthy, the yellow saturated beautifully. But the mushroom cloud behind her is backlit, its edges glowing with intensity the Eastmancolor clips to pure white. Shot through the window glass adding a faint interior reflection — a lamp, a curtain — ghosting over the scene. The palette is nightmare-pastoral: yellow sundress, green lawn, blue sky, white mushroom cloud, champagne amber.

prompts.title: 80s — Time Machine Cockpit
prompts.subject: a young man
prompts.text: A tight medium shot inside a time machine cockpit — analog-digital collision: genuine automotive gauges supplemented by a digital flux readout with red LEDs, Dymo-labeled toggles, a CRT date display, wiring held by cable ties and electrical tape. A young man grips the modified steering column, knuckles white, forearms tense with visible veins, wearing a down vest over plaid flannel with collar up, the nylon catching instrument lights in specular points. His face lit by the dashboard's mixed sources: warm amber gauges, red LED on his jaw, blue-white CRT on his forehead — three temperatures splitting his face into zones. Expression: wild, exhilarated, terrified — eyes wide, mouth open, hair blown back by a practical vent wind. Through the windshield: streaking light trails from fiber optics and long-exposure compositing. Shot on Kodak 5293 — grain heavy in the dark cockpit, mixed sources creating vivid color patchwork. Anamorphic flares from every LED and gauge. The palette is time-travel chaos: amber gauge, red LED, blue CRT, plaid flannel, white velocity streak.

prompts.title: 70s — Jungle Temple
prompts.subject: a young woman
prompts.text: A wide shot in Douglas Slocombe's lush visual register — a young woman at the entrance of a massive stone temple consumed by jungle, genuine location shooting with practical set extensions. She wears a khaki shirt darkened with sweat at the back, sleeves rolled showing tanned forearms with insect bites, canvas trousers tucked into mud-caked boots, a leather satchel with a worn brass buckle. Her hair in a utilitarian ponytail, escaping strands plastered to her neck, face showing tropical conditions: perspiration sheen, heat redness, sunburn beginning on her nose. The temple entrance: elaborate prop reliefs, weathering painted into foam, genuine moss grown on plaster over weeks, a real water trickle from a cracked lintel. Sunlight shafts penetrate the canopy in beams made solid by humidity and subtle haze. Shot on Kodak 5247 — lush green response making the jungle impossibly verdant, warm sunlight shafts glowing, grain fine. The palette is adventure-humid: jungle green, temple gray, khaki, leather, sunbeam gold, heat-flushed pink skin.

prompts.title: 80s — Android Assembly
prompts.subject: a young woman
prompts.text: A medium shot — a young woman on a chrome examination platform, neck down in perfect human form but face partially disassembled: left half normal skin, right half exposed mechanical substructure — servos, cables, an optical sensor. The blend between skin and appliance visible: pore texture difference, light response discontinuity where silicone begins. She wears a white tank top, arms human and natural — veins, muscle tone, a mole on her shoulder. The laboratory: workbenches with scattered components, a magnifying lamp, monitors showing wireframe facial schematics. Flat overhead fluorescents — shadowless, ideal for mechanical work and merciless on both skin and prosthetic. Shot on Kodak 5247 — grain fine enough for prosthetic detail, flat lighting revealing the texture difference with uncomfortable clarity. The palette is assembly-sterile: white, chrome, skin, cable-multicolor, fluorescent blue-white.

prompts.title: 60s — Moon Base Geologist
prompts.subject: a young man
prompts.text: A medium wide shot on a lunar surface set — calcium carbonate powder raked into dunes, a painted cyclorama of black space with an Earth globe on a slightly visible wire. A young man kneels beside a rock sample, his pressure suit with accordion-pleated joints, a gold-visored helmet under one arm showing a scratch from a previous take. His face after helmet removal: matted hair, red pressure line across forehead and cheeks from the seal, skin flushed from suit heat, sweat on his upper lip. The rock sample: a real geological specimen dressed with metallic paint showing brush strokes. On the ground: tool marks in the calcium carbonate from previous takes not raked smooth, boot prints with custom sole patterns. Lighting: a single massive arc from high camera-right simulating unfiltered sunlight, creating harsh shadows with no fill. Shot on 65mm Eastmancolor — extraordinary detail with minimal grain. The palette is moon-set: gray surface, black sky, white suit, gold visor, sweating human face warmth.

prompts.title: 80s — Swamp Planet Tracker
prompts.subject: a young woman
prompts.text: A low-angle shot from swamp-water level — the surface visible at the frame bottom with floating vegetation and a slight oil-residue rainbow. A young woman wades thigh-deep, creating V-shaped ripples catching filtered canopy light. She wears the remnants of a tactical vest with ripped pockets, a compression shirt torn at one sleeve revealing a makeshift bandage darkened with old brown blood. Cargo trousers soaked and heavy. Boots submerged, each step requiring visible effort. Her face: hollowed eyes, sunburned and peeling nose, cracked lips, hair matted into a mud-caked mass. She carries a machete with use marks and a nicked edge, paracord handle darkened with hand oils. The swamp: real water, real mud, practical Spanish moss, fog supplemented by hidden amber lights creating warm shafts. Shot on Kodak 5293 — heavy organic grain in the dark interior, greens at the stock's limits, amber shafts against cool green-blue shadow. Anamorphic flares from every light shaft. The palette is survival-primal: swamp green, mud, olive, amber sunlight, blood red-brown.

prompts.title: 70s — Forbidden Zone Wall
prompts.subject: a young woman
prompts.text: A wide shot in Gilbert Taylor's Star Wars visual language — a young woman before a massive wall of interlocking dark blocks in an unidentifiable material that absorbs light. The practical wall: painted plywood with extraordinary layered glazes creating the impression of semi-translucent material. She's tiny against this wall — wide angle exaggerating scale — wearing a hooded linen traveling cloak, leather garments, wrapped-shin boots, a belt with a short blade in a verdigrised brass scabbard. Hood pushed back revealing sweat-tangled hair, wind-chapped cheeks, campfire soot at her temple. She extends one hand toward the wall, not quite touching, fingers spread between reaching and recoiling. Shot on Kodak 5247 with wide Panavision — the wall fills the upper two-thirds, figure in the lower third. Grain fine, dark wall surface showing subtle invisible pattern. The palette is journey-worn: dark wall, linen, leather, warm skin, tarnished brass green.

prompts.title: 80s — Replicant Mirror
prompts.subject: a young woman
prompts.text: A medium close-up divided by a mirror — the young woman on the left, her reflection on the right. But the reflection is subtly wrong: the expression doesn't match — real face shows micro-tension, reflected face is fractionally more relaxed; real face has a lip tremor, reflection is still. She sits at a vanity in a luxury apartment — perfect books, a strategic orchid, a blanket folded too precisely. She wears a champagne silk camisole catching warm practicals differently on each side.
